leadText:
Delilah (Japanese: デカンタ Decanta) is a character of the day who appeared in Performing with Fiery Charm!. She is a "Showcase Expert" who acted as one of the judges of the Dendemille Town Rookie Class Pokémon Showcase along with Gena and Santo.

During the Theme Performance, she had her evaluate the Poké Puffs made by the s. They let Miette, Jessilia, and advance to the Freestyle Performance. At the end of the second round, she voted along with the audience to decide the winner of the Pokémon Showcase and was shown to vote for Jessie.
